messages:
devon: Quick thread 1: want to lock down behavior for 'probing' auto-fallbacks. Customers saw a burst cause a full flip.

nina: Agreed. Product stance: probing only, not full rollout flip, unless a corroborating signal (error or p95 latency) exists.

sam: Runtime can emit `fallback_probe` events with fields: probe_id, trigger_signal, bucket_count. We can also tag probe vs full-fallback.

charlie: Ops asks for mandatory hysteresis: probes must show 3/5 buckets breach OR a 60s sustained breach to escalate. Also require a 20s cooldown after any state change.

maria: UX: show probe state inline as "probe (rate_quota)" with a small timeline sparkline. Clicking opens details: sampled traces, probe_id, sample_rate, and a "promote to full" button for operators.

devon: About sampling: default low (0.25%) for quota probes. But customers with small volume need higher. Make it per-route and tenant-configurable.

sam: Will add sample_rate and tenant_overrides to the audit blob. Example: single-line audit: {"probe_id":"p-123","trigger":"rate_quota","sample_rate":0.0025,"tenant":"acme"} emitted by runtime.

nina: Product wants immutable operator actions captured: who promoted/demoted, exact policy snapshot (model pins, quant profiles, rollout version). Replay token required for the simulator.

charlie: Retention ask: keep full trace/snapshot for 14d, aggregated counters and probe metadata for 180d. Provide on-demand export for compliance holds.

maria: UI CTA: when operator promotes probe, create a confirmation modal that includes the policy snapshot and a link to 'view replay'. Also show sampling coverage so they understand how representative traces are.

devon: Action items: @sam add probe events + probe vs full flag; @charlie write hysteresis/cooldown defaults and export costs; @maria mock pill + promote modal; @nina spec operator-audit format + replay token. Sync tomorrow 11am.

opsbot: ci/rollouts/staging : smoke ok on canary routes.

maria: small follow-up 1: include a human-readable "why" sentence in the drawer (e.g., "3/5 buckets > quota threshold, p95 latency ok").

charlie: SGTM. Also add an operator grace override with optional expiration so manual holds don't stay forever.

devon: Great. I'll capture notes and open a short RFC. Thanks all :raised_hands:
